edges.reason: msg.sender is used for the isWhitelisted and balance based mint eligibility checks in mint()
msg.sender determines winnerlist eligibility and claimAmount in freeMint()
withdraw() is guarded by onlyOwner which requires owner() == msg.sender
msg.sender is the direct recipient of the ETH transferred in withdraw()
msg.sender is the target of the low-level value call, allowing it to reenter
block.timestamp is compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide when to freeze the starting index block
block.timestamp is compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in freeMint()
The constructor assigns REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from block.timestamp
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP gates the startingIndexBlock assignment inside mint()
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP gates the startingIndexBlock assignment inside freeMint()
MAX_ELEMENTS bounds the total minted amount in mint()
MAX_ELEMENTS bounds the total minted amount in freeMint()
whitelist mapping is read and its hasMinted counter is updated inside mint()
winnerlist mapping claimAmount is read and decreased inside freeMint()
addAddressToWhitelist writes the whitelist mapping entry
winnerlist claimAmount bounds the user supplied free mint count
privateMintPrice is used in the private sale value check
publicMintPrice is used in the public sale value check
startingIndexBlock is read to derive the pseudorandom starting index
startingIndex is assigned inside setStartingIndex()
withdraw() performs an external value call to msg.sender which can execute arbitrary code before completion
The contract balance local is passed as the value of the low-level call in withdraw()
partialWithdraw() performs an external value call to an arbitrary address
The caller supplied _to parameter is the target of the partialWithdraw low-level call
The caller supplied _amount parameter is the value of the partialWithdraw low-level call
_count is multiplied by the mint price in the arithmetic value check inside mint()
privateMintPrice participates in the multiplication arithmetic checked against msg.value
publicMintPrice participates in the multiplication arithmetic checked against msg.value
_count is subtracted from winnerlist claimAmount in freeMint()
winnerlist claimAmount is the operand mutated by the freeMint subtraction
The cached total supply local is used for the supply and index block checks in mint()
setWhitelistAddr loops over addresses and invokes addAddressToWhitelist
addAddressToWhitelist is guarded by onlyOwner comparing owner() with msg.sender
partialWithdraw() is guarded by onlyOwner which requires owner() == msg.sender
Only the owner (msg.sender == owner()) can reach the withdraw low-level call

normalization_plan.reason: The _count parameter is only meaningful within mint() and drives the supply, price and whitelist checks there
The _amount parameter is only meaningful within partialWithdraw() and feeds the value of the low-level call
The _to parameter is only meaningful within partialWithdraw() and is the destination of the low-level call
The freeMint _count parameter is only meaningful within freeMint() and drives the claimAmount subtraction
The total local is a transient cache of totalSupply() used solely inside mint()
The balance local is a transient cache of address(this).balance used solely inside withdraw()
